category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Actor as unit of deployment
what: An Actor is a serverless cloud program that takes structured JSON input, does a job (scrape/automate/process) and produces structured output; it can be run from Console, API, CLI, schedule, or by other Actors.
how: Actor = Dockerfile + README.md + input/output schemas + default storages + metadata (name, description, author, version). Visibility private or public (Store). Runs manually, via REST, CLI, scheduler, or Actor-to-Actor calls.
verevonRelevance: Quarry's 'platform half' needs an equivalent packaged-unit abstraction (code + schema + storages) if Verevon wants a catalogue of crawlers/agents.
notes: Apify's core abstraction since ~2017; the most mature 'serverless scraper' packaging model among peers.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: actor.json definition file
what: A single .actor/actor.json links a local project to a platform Actor and declares all metadata and schemas.
how: Fields: actorSpecification(=1), name, version (MAJOR.MINOR), buildTag (default latest), environmentVariables, dockerfile, readme, input (or inputSchema), storages {dataset,keyValueStore,datasets}, webServerSchema (OpenAPI 3), webServerMcpPath, usesStandbyMode, minMemoryMbytes, maxMemoryMbytes, changelog. name/version/buildTag/env only applied via CLI deploy.
verevonRelevance: A declarative manifest (schemas + runtime hints + MCP path) is a good pattern for Quarry 'crawler packs' or integration-corev2 provider actions.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Input schema -> auto-generated UI + validation
what: Declaring a JSON input schema makes Console render a form automatically and validates API/UI input; required to publish to Store.
how: schemaVersion 1; types string/integer/number/boolean/array/object/resource; editors e.g. textfield, textarea, javascript, python, select, datepicker, fileupload, hidden, number, checkbox, json, requestListSources, pseudoUrls, globs, keyValue, stringList, schemaBased, proxy, resourcePicker. Keywords: default, prefill, example, pattern/min/max/minItems/uniqueItems/nullable, enum/enumTitles/enumSuggestedValues, dateType, isSecret, sectionCaption/groupCaption, unit, errorMessage, resourceType/resourcePermissions/mcpServers. Max 500 kB.
verevonRelevance: Verevon could render Quarry job and integration-action parameter forms from the same schema the Model Plane uses for tool-calling; domain-specific editors (proxy, globs, requestListSources) are directly reusable ideas.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Secret input fields (isSecret)
what: Input fields marked isSecret are encrypted end-to-end so only the running Actor can read them.
how: Hybrid encryption: AES-256-GCM random key wrapped with a 2048-bit RSA key unique per (user, Actor) pair; stored in run KV store as ENCRYPTED_VALUE:...; decrypted by Actor.getInput() using APIFY_INPUT_SECRETS_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE/PASSPHRASE env vars inside the run. Supported for string/object/array (SDK JS 3.1+/3.4.2+, Python 2.7+).
verevonRelevance: Relevant for Verevon's credential vault / browser-login secrets: per-(user,tool) key pairs and in-container-only decryption is a sound pattern.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Output schema (where results live)
what: An output schema declares named outputs as URL templates so Console (Output tab) and agents know where results are.
how: .actor/output_schema.json: actorOutputSchemaVersion 1, title, properties{id:{title,description,template}}; template vars links.apiDefaultDatasetUrl, links.apiDefaultKeyValueStoreUrl, run.containerUrl, storages.datasets.<name>.apiUrl; GET Run returns 'output' with resolved URLs; empty properties shows Log tab instead.
verevonRelevance: Quarry runs could publish a typed 'output map' that the Data Plane and Model Plane consume uniformly.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Dataset schema: fields + views
what: Dataset schema both validates items (JSON Schema) and configures how Console displays them (views), and gives agents field metadata.
how: storages.dataset: fields (JSON Schema w/ title/description/example/enum), views[] with transformation {fields, unwind, flatten, omit, limit, desc} and display {component: table, properties{label, format: text|number|date|link|boolean|image|array|object}}; first view default; multiple named datasets supported; views don't change exports.
verevonRelevance: Field metadata for AI agents + view config is a good pattern for Quarry result sets surfaced in Verevon workspace tables.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Versions, builds and build numbers
what: Each Actor can have multiple MAJOR.MINOR versions; each is built into a Docker image with an auto-incremented build number.
how: Build number MAJOR.MINOR.BUILD (e.g. 1.2.345); build default 1800 s timeout / 4096 MB; build statuses READY->RUNNING->SUCCEEDED/FAILED/TIMED-OUT/ABORTED; untagged unused builds deleted after 90 days.
verevonRelevance: Versioned immutable builds with tags are the right model for Quarry extractors and integration-corev2 provider actions.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Build tags (latest/beta) and pinning
what: Users select builds by tag or exact number; tags move between builds via the Actor update API.
how: Each tag maps to exactly one build; version's buildTag property auto-tags successful builds; pin exact numbers to avoid breaking changes.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Build cache
what: Builds reuse cached Docker layers by default; a clean build can be forced.
how: API: useCache=0 forces clean build; Console: Source > Code > Build options > Clean build; cache is best-effort.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Source types: Web IDE, Git, Zip, Gist

AI, AGENTS, MCP_SERVERS, INTEGRATIONS; listing signals: users, star ratings, 30-day run stats, currentPricingInfo tiers, isWhiteListedForAgenticPayments; Top-100 by recency-weighted popularity; Oct 6 2026 changelog: use-case categories + filters (industry, output type, target site, actor type).

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Store pricing models: PPE, PPE+usage, pay-per-usage, (rental sunset)
what: Paid Actors are billed per developer-defined events, optionally plus platform usage; rental (monthly fee) Actors are being retired.
how: Pay-per-event: fixed price per event (result, start, upload...); 'pay per event + usage' adds compute; pay-per-usage: only platform CU/storage/proxy. Rental: no new rentals after 2026-04-01, remaining converted to pay-per-usage on 2026-10-01. Users set max charge per run and are never charged above it.
verevonRelevance: Per-event metering with user-set caps maps to Verevon's Model Plane cost tracking for browser/crawl jobs.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Pay-per-event charging SDK
what: Actor code programmatically charges events; platform enforces the user's max-total-charge budget and aborts when reached.
how: Actor.charge({eventName,count}) / Actor.pushData(data,eventName) return ChargeResult {eventChargeLimitReached, chargeableWithinLimit, chargedCount}; ChargingManager.getMaxTotalChargeUsd(), calculateMaxEventChargeCountWithinLimit(), getPricingInfo(); env ACTOR_MAX_TOTAL_CHARGE_USD; local test via ACTOR_TEST_PAY_PER_EVENT=true writing to charging-log dataset ($1 default per event).
verevonRelevance: Pattern for budget-aware browsing: the executor (Quarry) checks remaining budget before each billable step and shuts down gracefully.

how: Eight factors: reliability (success rate, automated tests), popularity, feedback, ease of use, pricing transparency, trustworthiness (limited permissions), developer history, congruency of title/description/schemas/README; recalculated several times daily; visible in Console > Insights > Actor quality.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs

how: Free $0 ($5 usage), Starter $19, Scale $199, Business $999 (annual -10%); CU price $0.20/$0.20/$0.16/$0.13; max RAM 16/64/256/512 GB; concurrent runs 5 (pricing page) or 25 (limits page) / 32 / 128 / 256; overage billed up to user-set limit; unused credit expires; add-ons: concurrent run $5, RAM $1/GB.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Memory->CPU->disk resource model
what: Run memory selects CPU share and disk: 4096 MB = 1 core, disk = 2x memory; powers of two 128 MB-32 GB.
how: CU = memory(MB) x hours with 1-second granularity; free CPU boost at startup; APIFY_DEDICATED_CPUS env var; per-user combined memory cap (16/64/256/512 GB).
verevonRelevance: Simple, explainable sizing knob worth copying for Verevon sandboxes/browser sessions.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Three storage primitives per run
what: Every run automatically gets a default key-value store (input), dataset (results) and request queue (URLs).
how: IDs exposed via ACTOR_DEFAULT_DATASET_ID / _KEY_VALUE_STORE_ID / _REQUEST_QUEUE_ID and ACTOR_STORAGES_JSON; addressable by id, ~name or username~name; named storages kept indefinitely, unnamed expire (7 days default; free plan: last 10 runs 4 months).

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Dataset (append-only result table)

how: Formats JSON (default), JSONL, CSV, HTML table, XLSX, XML, RSS; params format, fields, omit (nested paths), clean/skipHidden (fields starting with #), xmlRoot/xmlRow; item <= 9 MB; tabular exports <= 2,000 columns; push 400 rps, other 60 rps; concurrent reads/writes; strong consistency (S3).

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Key-value store (blob/state store)
what: Mutable record store for any MIME type (JSON, HTML, images, zips) used for input, output, screenshots and state.
how: Keys <= 256 chars [a-zA-Z0-9!-_.'()]; records stored with content type; optional Content-Encoding compression; list keys with exclusiveStartKey pagination; 200 rps CRUD, 100 rps zip download; INPUT and INPUT-METAMORPH-N conventions; Actor.useState() persists state here.

category: Platform & ecosystem — actors/marketplace/store, templates/presets, datasets/key-value/storage, integrations/connectors, versioning/builds, monetization/billing/credits, teams/orgs
name: Key-value store collections schema

how: key_value_store.json collections; output templates like {{links.apiDefaultKeyValueStoreUrl}}/keys?collection=screenshots; single record (e.g. /records/report.html) can render inline in Output tab.

name: Request queue (persistent URL frontier)
what: A persistent, deduplicated queue of requests supporting BFS/DFS order, forefront insertion, batch ops and reuse across runs for incremental crawling.
how: Request {id, uniqueKey, url, method, payload, headers, userData, retryCount}; uniqueKey dedup; forefront:true; batchAddRequests/batchDeleteRequests; reclaimRequest; named queues persist indefinitely, unnamed 7 days; rate limits 350 rps CRUD/lock, 35 rps batch+listAndLockHead.

category: Orchestration & scale — queues, concurrency, scheduling/cron, distributed workers, request queue/URL frontier, dedup, crawl scoping/filters/sitemaps, budgets/limits, priority
name: Request locking for multiple consumers
what: Several runs/clients can consume one queue safely via leases on head requests.
how: listAndLockHead(lockSecs) returns requests with lockExpiresAt/lockByClient; prolongRequestLock / deleteRequestLock; locks scoped to clientKey (1-32 chars) or run; hadMultipleClients flag; expired locks make requests available again.
verevonRelevance: Enables distributed Quarry workers sharing one frontier.

name: Actor Standby (always-on HTTP API mode)
